main_text.head: NEC VNVS ABBAS PLVRIBVS MONASTERIIS PRAESIDERE.
DE IEIVNIO.
CAPVT. XXX.
main_text.p: Depœnit. Dist. 5. C. Sint tibi.) Sint tibi quotidiana ieiunia, & refectio satietatem fugiens. Nihil enim prodest tibi biduo vel triduo transmisso vacuum portare ventrem, si post pariter obstruatur.
Et mox C. Sint tibi ieiunia pura, continua moderataque, id est, quotidie esurire, & quotidie prandere.
Item. C. Nihil enim prodest homini ieiunare & orare, & alia religionis bona agere, nisi mens ab iniquitate, & ab obtrectationibus prohibeatur.
Item. C. Non mediocriter. Nonne rationabiliter homo dignitatem amittit, qui vel ieiunium charitati, aut vigilias praefert sensus integritati?
Item. C. Ieiunium. Ieiunium autem magnum & generale est abstinere ab iniquitatibus, & ab illicitis voluptatibus saeculi. Quod est perfectum ieiunium in hoc saeculo.

page.notes: Printed as "Depœnit. Dist. 5. C. Sint tibi." in italic with the closing parenthesis; the sigla "Dist." and "C." are kept as printed. Long s appears as s throughout. Words such as "transmisso", "praefert", "ieiunium" and "saeculo" are read from the scan and are slightly uncertain where the type is worn; the line "Nihil enim prodest tibi biduo vel triduo transmisso" is read as printed. The "?" at the end of "integritati" is a printed question mark, not a reading doubt. Signature "K 2" is at the foot right of the text block.
